 Introduction 
 Matt 
This is Matt Reustle and today, we are breaking down HEICO. On the surface, HEICO is an aerospace business. They most notably operate in the aircraft parts and repairs market. And HEICO is another case study of a very successful business in a nonobvious niche market.

 To break down HEICO, I was joined by Eric Ruden, Analyst at Ironvine Capital. Eric does an incredible job of explaining the HEICO story with some simple analogies to other industries, and he brings numbers to frame the value proposition of exactly what HEICO is doing. We cover the fascinating story of the Mendelson family and how they've built HEICO into what it is today. And if you haven't listened to the 50X Podcast on TransDigm, it makes for an excellent pairing with this HEICO breakdown. So please enjoy this breakdown on HEICO.
